question: Why is regular physical exercise important for your body? 🏃
options: It keeps our muscles and heart strong 💪
It is only for professional athletes 🏆
It helps us sleep all day 🛌
answer: It keeps our muscles and heart strong 💪
explanation: Great job! Physical activity makes our heart and muscles stronger, helps us grow, and keeps us happy and energetic every day! 💪
hint: Think about what happens when you run and play.

question: What is the main goal of Physical Education in school? 🏫
options: Overall physical, mental, and social development 🌟
answer: Overall physical, mental, and social development 🌟
explanation: Awesome! Physical Education teaches us to be healthy, work as a team, and grow strong both physically and mentally! 🌟
hint: It helps you grow in every possible way!

question: What does being 'Healthy' truly mean? 🍏
options: Complete physical, mental, and social well-being 🌈
Eating a lot of junk food 🍔
answer: Complete physical, mental, and social well-being 🌈
explanation: Excellent! True health means your body feels good, your mind is happy, and you get along well with others! 🌈
hint: It is about feeling good in your body, mind, and heart.

question: What is 'Physical Fitness'? 🏋️
options: The ability to do daily tasks easily without getting too tired 🔋
answer: The ability to do daily tasks easily without getting too tired 🔋
explanation: Fantastic! When you are physically fit, you have plenty of energy to study, play, and help at home without feeling exhausted! 🔋
hint: It means having lots of energy for your daily activities.

question: Which of these is a mental benefit of playing sports? 🧠
options: It helps you focus better on your studies 📖
answer: It helps you focus better on your studies 📖
explanation: Brilliant! Playing sports increases blood flow to the brain, which makes your memory sharper and helps you concentrate in class! 📖
hint: Think about how fresh your mind feels after playing.

question: How does playing games with friends help you socially? 🤝
options: It teaches us teamwork and cooperation 👯
answer: It teaches us teamwork and cooperation 👯
explanation: Superb! Team games teach us how to share, communicate, and work together to achieve a common goal! 👯
hint: It is about doing things together with others.

question: Why do we sweat when we exercise? 💦
options: To cool our body down and remove waste 🌡️
Because we drank too much juice 🧃
answer: To cool our body down and remove waste 🌡️
explanation: Wonderful! Sweating is your body's smart way of acting like an air conditioner to keep you cool when you get hot from playing! 🌡️
hint: It works like a natural cooling system for your skin.

question: Which healthy habit should you do right after a sweaty game? 🚿
options: Take a bath and wear clean clothes 🧼
Sit in front of the AC ❄️
answer: Take a bath and wear clean clothes 🧼
explanation: Perfect! Bathing washes away sweat and germs, keeping your skin fresh, clean, and healthy! 🧼
hint: Think about how to get clean after getting dirty.

question: How many hours of sleep does a Class 6 student need every night to stay healthy? 😴
answer: 8 to 10 hours 🌙
explanation: Awesome! A good 8 to 10 hours of sleep helps your body repair itself and gives you super energy for the next day! 🌙
hint: It is between 7 and 11 hours.

question: What should you drink plenty of to stay hydrated while playing? 💧
answer: Clean drinking water 🚰
explanation: Great job! Water is the best drink for your body. It keeps your muscles working smoothly and prevents you from feeling dizzy! 🚰
hint: It is a clear liquid that has no sugar.

question: What do we call the exercises we do BEFORE starting a heavy game or sport? 🤸
answer: Warming up 🔥
explanation: Excellent! Warming up prepares your heart and muscles for the game, making sure you can play your best safely! 🔥
hint: You want to make your body warm and ready.

question: Why is 'Warming up' so important? 🔥
options: It gets our muscles ready and prevents injuries 🛡️
It makes us tired before the game 😓
answer: It gets our muscles ready and prevents injuries 🛡️
explanation: Fantastic! Stretching and light jogging before a game keep your muscles flexible and protect you from getting hurt! 🛡️
hint: It keeps you safe from pulling a muscle.

question: What should we do to calm our breathing AFTER playing a tough match? 🧘
options: Drink a whole jug of water very fast 🚰
answer: Do cool-down exercises and stretch 🧊
explanation: Brilliant! Cooling down slowly brings your heart rate back to normal and helps your muscles relax! 🧊
hint: You want to 'cool' your body back to normal.

question: Which of the following is an example of good personal hygiene? 🧼
options: Washing hands with soap before eating 🧴
answer: Washing hands with soap before eating 🧴
explanation: Superb! Washing your hands kills tiny germs and keeps you from falling sick. It is a super healthy habit! 🧴
hint: Think about what you do before a meal to stay clean.

question: How does staying active help your bones? 🦴
options: It makes them strong and healthy 🧱
answer: It makes them strong and healthy 🧱
explanation: Wonderful! Jumping, running, and playing put healthy pressure on your bones, making them grow stronger and denser! 🧱
hint: It makes your skeleton tough like a shield.

question: Which component of fitness helps you bend and touch your toes easily? 🧘
answer: Flexibility 🤸
explanation: Perfect! Flexibility allows your joints and muscles to move freely without stiffness. Stretching daily improves it! 🤸
hint: It is what gymnasts are very good at.

question: Which fitness component is needed to run a very long distance without stopping? 🏃
answer: Endurance or Stamina 🔋
explanation: Awesome! Stamina helps your heart and lungs work for a long time so you don't get tired quickly during a long race! 🔋
hint: It is like having a big battery of energy.

question: What is the best way to maintain a correct sitting posture while studying? 🪑
answer: Keeping your back straight 📏
explanation: Great job! A straight back keeps your spine healthy, prevents backaches, and helps you breathe better! 📏
hint: Think of sitting tall like a tree.

question: How does exercise affect our mood and feelings? 😊
options: It releases happy chemicals (endorphins) and makes us cheerful 🌟
It makes us angry at friends 😠
answer: It releases happy chemicals (endorphins) and makes us cheerful 🌟
explanation: Excellent! When you play, your brain releases 'feel-good' chemicals called endorphins that naturally make you smile! 🌟
hint: It is the reason you feel great after a fun game.

question: If you play a team sport like football or kabaddi, what important life skill do you learn? ⚽
options: How to fight with the referee 🛑
answer: Teamwork and sportsmanship 🤝
explanation: Fantastic! Team sports teach us how to support our friends, respect the rules, and win or lose with a smile! 🤝
hint: It involves working nicely with others.

question: What does 'Sportsmanship' mean? 🏆
options: Respecting the rules, opponents, and officials 🤝
answer: Respecting the rules, opponents, and officials 🤝
explanation: Brilliant! Good sportsmanship means playing fair, treating everyone with respect, and shaking hands after the game! 🤝
hint: It is about being fair and polite on the field.

question: Why should we cut our nails regularly? ✂️
options: To prevent dirt and germs from hiding under them 🦠
answer: To prevent dirt and germs from hiding under them 🦠
explanation: Superb! Short, clean nails stop harmful germs from entering our food when we eat, keeping us safe and healthy! 🦠
hint: Think about what gets stuck underneath them when you play in the mud.

question: What happens if we spend too much time sitting and looking at screens (phones/TV)? 📱
options: It can harm our eyes and make our body lazy 🛋️
answer: It can harm our eyes and make our body lazy 🛋️
explanation: Wonderful! Taking breaks from screens to go play outside protects your eyes and keeps your muscles strong and active! 🛋️
hint: It means staying in one place for too long.

question: Which of these activities helps to improve cardiovascular (heart) health? ❤️
answer: Brisk walking or jogging 🏃
explanation: Perfect! Activities that make you breathe faster, like jogging or cycling, make your heart pump stronger and healthier! 🏃
hint: It is an activity that makes your heart beat faster.

question: How often should we exercise or play outdoor games? 🌞
options: Regularly, at least 60 minutes a day ⏱️
answer: Regularly, at least 60 minutes a day ⏱️
explanation: Awesome! Playing outside for at least an hour every day is the magic rule to staying fit, happy, and super energetic! ⏱️
hint: It is a daily healthy habit.

question: What is the correct way to lift a heavy object to protect your back? 📦
options: Bend your knees and keep your back straight 🦵
answer: Bend your knees and keep your back straight 🦵
explanation: Great job! Using your strong leg muscles instead of your back protects your spine from getting hurt! 🦵
hint: Use your leg muscles, not your spine.

question: Which of these is a healthy snack after playing? 🍎
answer: Fresh fruits 🍎
explanation: Excellent! Fresh fruits give your body natural energy and vitamins to repair your muscles after a fun game! 🍎
hint: It is a natural, sweet food that grows on trees.

question: Why is oxygen important when we run? 🌬️
options: Our muscles need it to produce energy 🔋
answer: Our muscles need it to produce energy 🔋
explanation: Fantastic! When you breathe deeply while running, oxygen travels to your muscles and gives them the power to keep moving! 🔋
hint: It acts like fuel for a car.

question: What is emotional well-being? 💖
options: Understanding and managing our feelings in a positive way 🌟
answer: Understanding and managing our feelings in a positive way 🌟
explanation: Brilliant! Emotional well-being means knowing how you feel and knowing healthy ways to express it, like talking to a friend or playing! 🌟
hint: It is about keeping your heart and mind happy.

question: How can deep breathing exercises (like Pranayama) help you? 🧘
options: They calm your mind and reduce stress 🌬️
answer: They calm your mind and reduce stress 🌬️
explanation: Superb! Taking slow, deep breaths relaxes your body, slows down your heart rate, and clears your mind! 🌬️
hint: It brings peace to your brain.

question: What is 'Personal Hygiene'? 🧼
options: Keeping your own body, hair, and teeth clean and healthy 🪥
answer: Keeping your own body, hair, and teeth clean and healthy 🪥
explanation: Wonderful! Good personal hygiene like bathing and brushing teeth everyday keeps away sickness and makes you feel fresh! 🪥
hint: It is about taking care of your own body.

question: Why should we wear comfortable and breathable clothes while playing? 👕
options: To allow sweat to dry and let our body move freely 🏃
answer: To allow sweat to dry and let our body move freely 🏃
explanation: Perfect! Cotton and sports fabrics let your skin breathe, keeping you cool and comfortable while you run and jump! 🏃
hint: You need to move easily without getting too hot.

question: Which of the following helps to build strong muscles? 💪
answer: Eating healthy protein and exercising 🥚
explanation: Awesome! Exercise tells your muscles to grow, and healthy foods give them the building blocks they need! 🥚
hint: It is a mix of good food and hard work.

question: How does Physical Education help you in your classroom? 🏫
options: It makes you sleep in class 💤
It improves memory, attention, and learning power 🧠
It makes you forget your homework 📓
answer: It improves memory, attention, and learning power 🧠
explanation: Great job! Kids who are physically active have sharper brains and find it easier to concentrate on their studies! 🧠
hint: It exercises your brain too!

question: What is 'Agility'? 🐇
options: The ability to change direction quickly and easily ⚡
The ability to eat very fast 🍽️
The ability to sit still for hours 🗿
answer: The ability to change direction quickly and easily ⚡
explanation: Excellent! Agility is a super skill in sports like basketball or kabaddi, where you have to dodge and change direction in a flash! ⚡
hint: Think of how a rabbit quickly dodges.

question: Why should you NOT play a heavy sport immediately after eating a large meal? 🍲
options: It can cause a stomach ache because the body is digesting food 🤢
It makes you run too fast 🏎️
answer: It can cause a stomach ache because the body is digesting food 🤢
explanation: Fantastic! Your stomach needs time to break down food. Always wait a little while after eating before you run fast! 🤢
hint: Think about how your tummy feels when it's very full.

question: What does a balanced lifestyle include? ⚖️
options: A good mix of study, play, rest, and healthy food 🥗
answer: A good mix of study, play, rest, and healthy food 🥗
explanation: Brilliant! A healthy life is all about balance. Studying, playing, eating right, and resting are all equally important! 🥗
hint: It means giving equal time to all good things.

question: Why do we feel out of breath after a fast sprint? 🏃
options: Because we forgot how to breathe 🤷
Because our body needs extra oxygen quickly to make energy 🌬️
answer: Because our body needs extra oxygen quickly to make energy 🌬️
explanation: Superb! Sprinting uses up energy very fast. Breathing heavily is just your body's way of quickly bringing in more oxygen to refuel! 🌬️
hint: Your muscles are asking for more air.

question: Which body system pumps blood and oxygen to your muscles when you play? ❤️
answer: The cardiovascular (heart) system ❤️
explanation: Wonderful! Your strong heart pumps blood like a delivery truck, taking oxygen and nutrients right to your working muscles! ❤️
hint: It is related to the heart.

question: What is 'Coordination' in sports? 🤹
options: Using different parts of your body together smoothly, like hand-eye coordination 👁️
answer: Using different parts of your body together smoothly, like hand-eye coordination 👁️
explanation: Perfect! Catching a ball requires your eyes and hands to work together perfectly. That is awesome coordination! 👁️
hint: It is about making your eyes and hands work as a team.

question: Why is it important to wash your sports shoes regularly? 👟
options: To prevent bad smell and fungal infections from sweat 🦠
answer: To prevent bad smell and fungal infections from sweat 🦠
explanation: Awesome! Clean shoes keep your feet healthy, smelling good, and free from itchy infections! 🦠
hint: Sweaty shoes can be a home for germs.

question: What should you do if your friend falls and gets a small cut while playing? 🩹
options: Help them wash the cut and inform an adult or teacher 👩‍🏫
answer: Help them wash the cut and inform an adult or teacher 👩‍🏫
explanation: Great job! Helping a friend shows great sportsmanship and kindness. A clean bandage will have them smiling again soon! 👩‍🏫
hint: Think about what you would want someone to do for you.

question: Which of these is a fun way to stay physically active without playing a formal sport? 💃
answer: Dancing to your favorite songs 🎶
explanation: Excellent! Dancing is an amazing, joyful workout! It keeps your heart healthy and brings a big smile to your face! 🎶
hint: It involves moving to music.

question: How does regular exercise keep sickness away? 🛡️
options: It strengthens our immune system, helping the body fight germs 🦠
It makes germs scared of our muscles 💪
It stops us from going outside 🏠
answer: It strengthens our immune system, helping the body fight germs 🦠
explanation: Fantastic! Playing outside naturally boosts your body's defenses, making you strong enough to fight off colds and bugs! 🦠
hint: It makes your body's internal army stronger.

question: What does 'Wellness' mean? 🌻
options: Being free from illness and having a happy, balanced life 🌈
answer: Being free from illness and having a happy, balanced life 🌈
explanation: Brilliant! Wellness is the total package! It means you are taking great care of your body, mind, and spirit every single day! 🌈
hint: It means total health and happiness.

question: Why is proper footwear (like sports shoes) important when playing? 👟
options: To protect our feet and prevent slipping and injuries 🛡️
answer: To protect our feet and prevent slipping and injuries 🛡️
explanation: Superb! Good shoes support your ankles and give you grip, keeping you safe while you run fast and play hard! 🛡️
hint: They keep your feet safe from getting hurt.

question: Which activity is best for improving both your physical balance and your mental focus? 🧘
answer: Yoga 🧘
explanation: Wonderful! Yoga stretches your body, improves your balance, and teaches your mind to focus beautifully! 🧘
hint: It involves breathing and holding poses.

question: Why should we avoid drinking too many sugary sodas? 🥤
options: They can harm our teeth and make us unhealthy 🦷
answer: They can harm our teeth and make us unhealthy 🦷
explanation: Perfect! Too much sugar is bad for your strong teeth and body. Fresh water is always the absolute best choice! 🦷
hint: Sugar can cause cavities.

question: What is a great habit to have every morning to start the day fresh? 🌅
options: Waking up and immediately watching TV 📺
Doing a few stretching exercises and drinking water 🧘
Eating a big bowl of ice cream 🍨
answer: Doing a few stretching exercises and drinking water 🧘
explanation: Awesome! A nice morning stretch wakes up your muscles, and a glass of water hydrates your body for an energetic day ahead! 🧘
hint: It wakes up your muscles nicely.

question: How does Physical Education teach you to handle losing a game? 🤝
options: It teaches you to cry loudly 😭
It teaches you to gracefully accept defeat and try harder next time 🌟
It teaches you to blame the referee 🗣️
It teaches you to stop playing forever 🛑
answer: It teaches you to gracefully accept defeat and try harder next time 🌟
explanation: Great job! In sports, as in life, we learn that losing is just a chance to learn, improve, and bounce back stronger! 🌟
hint: It teaches you never to give up.
